title: triraphis abyssinica
intro: Triraphis abyssinica, commonly known as Khat, is a flowering plant native to the Horn of Africa and the Arabian Peninsula. It is valued for its leaves, which contain bioactive constituents that provide various health benefits, including reducing fatigue, improving cognitive function, and acting as a natural stimulant. The therapeutic actions of Triraphis abyssinica include its ability to increase alertness, enhance mood, and reduce symptoms of depression and anxiety, although its long-term use can lead to negative effects such as addiction and sleep disturbances. The bioactive constituents of Triraphis abyssinica include alkaloids like cathinone and cathine, which are responsible for its stimulant and psychoactive properties.
